title: 4-Way Conveyor

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Conveyor belt that goes in 4 different directions

body:
The 4 Way Conveyor can be used as a single Conveyor except it can move any object at all 4 directions. This has no square box to connect to any logic structures. It can however be switched directions by an interactor like other conveyors.

When facing the conveyor's direction switch and connecting an interactor to switch direction with power outputs, use these numbers as outputs:

Output of 0 - RIGHT

Output of 2 - LEFT

Output of 8 - BACK

Output of 10 - FRONT

There is also a direction for the conveyor to not move ( also like other conveyors ) , though it does not appear to have an input value.
